## DOMAINS

### Esthétique et philosophie de l'art

Groups: 3 · Skills: 11

[aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Aesthetic inquiry asks why experiences, works, and environments are judged beautiful, expressive, meaningful, or artistically valuable. Its focus is justification and concepts of value, not techniques of making art.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi les gens trouvent certaines expériences et œuvres belles ou précieuses.

#### Jugement esthétique

Skills: 4

[aestheticJudgment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/aestheticJudgment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An aesthetic evaluation can invoke perceptual qualities, interpretation, tradition, or standards that other observers may dispute.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment on peut justifier une opinion esthétique par des raisons.

##### Analyser le rôle du contexte dans l'expérience esthétique

[analyzeTheRoleOfContextInAestheticExperience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/analyzeTheRoleOfContextInAestheticExperience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how setting, background knowledge, and cultural conventions can alter interpretation while the object remains unchanged.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment le contexte ou les connaissances préalables transforment l'expérience esthétique.

##### Comparer les approches objectives et subjectives de la beauté

[compareObjectiveAndSubjectiveAccountsOfBeauty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/compareObjectiveAndSubjectiveAccountsOfBeauty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether aesthetic assessments can be reasoned about beyond individual preference without assuming universal consensus.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les idées sur la possibilité de juger la beauté au-delà du goût personnel.

##### Distinguer valeur esthétique et valeur instrumentale

[distinguishAestheticFromInstrumentalValue.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/distinguishAestheticFromInstrumentalValue.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why something may be appreciated for its appearance or experience rather than its practical usefulness.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue la beauté ou la force expressive d'un objet de son utilité pratique.

##### Justifier un jugement esthétique

[justifyAnAestheticJudgment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/justifyAnAestheticJudgment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Support an appraisal with relevant features and criteria rather than simply reporting that one likes or dislikes an object.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique une évaluation esthétique par des caractéristiques pertinentes plutôt que le seul goût personnel.

#### Art et interprétation

Skills: 4

[artAndInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/artAndInterpretation/artAndInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A work can bear meanings and values that are not reducible to the creator's stated intent or a viewer's immediate reaction.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réfléchis à la manière dont les œuvres transmettent des sens au-delà des intentions de leurs créateurs.

##### Analyser l'évaluation éthique de l'art

[analyzeTheEthicalEvaluationOfArt.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/artAndInterpretation/skills/analyzeTheEthicalEvaluationOfArt.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explore whether and how moral concerns about content, production, or reception bear on artistic appraisal.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine si des préoccupations morales devraient influencer le jugement artistique.

##### Comparer des interprétations d'une œuvre

[compareInterpretationsOfAnArtwork.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/artAndInterpretation/skills/compareInterpretationsOfAnArtwork.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate rival readings by their attention to the work's features and context rather than assuming every reading is equally supported.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les interprétations à partir des caractéristiques et de l'histoire de l'œuvre.

##### Distinguer intention artistique et interprétation

[distinguishArtisticIntentionFromInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/artAndInterpretation/skills/distinguishArtisticIntentionFromInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess what a creator reportedly intended separately from meanings supported by the work and its reception.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Sépare les intentions de l'artiste des interprétations appuyées par l'œuvre.

##### Évaluer une définition de l'art

[evaluateADefinitionOfArt.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/artAndInterpretation/skills/evaluateADefinitionOfArt.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test a proposed criterion against borderline cases, changing practices, and works that challenge established categories.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Teste des définitions de l'art avec des exemples inhabituels ou difficiles à classer.

#### Valeur et goût

Skills: 3

[valueAndTaste.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/valueAndTaste/valueAndTaste.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Debates about taste raise questions about expertise, social convention, and the relation of appreciation to human flourishing.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les goûts personnels, l'expertise et les traditions culturelles influencent l'appréciation.

##### Analyser le pluralisme esthétique

[analyzeAestheticPluralism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/valueAndTaste/skills/analyzeAestheticPluralism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how multiple traditions can sustain meaningful standards without requiring one global ranking of their forms.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment différentes traditions artistiques peuvent disposer de critères de valeur pertinents.

##### Distinguer goût et évaluation argumentée

[distinguishTasteFromAnArguedEvaluation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/valueAndTaste/skills/distinguishTasteFromAnArguedEvaluation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a personal reaction and a defensible public judgment may overlap but require different kinds of support.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais la différence entre aimer une chose et justifier son évaluation.

##### Évaluer le rôle de l'expertise dans le jugement esthétique

[evaluateTheRoleOfExpertiseInAestheticJudgment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/valueAndTaste/skills/evaluateTheRoleOfExpertiseInAestheticJudgment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider how practiced perception and historical knowledge may inform an assessment without making expert preferences infallible.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réfléchis à la manière dont l'expertise éclaire les jugements sans rendre les experts infaillibles.

### Épistémologie et évaluation critique

Groups: 4 · Skills: 19

[epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Questions about knowledge concern what can be believed responsibly, what makes claims true, and when confidence should change. This domain applies general standards of justification to testimony and public information; scientific experimental design has its own domain.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore ce qui justifie une croyance et comment évaluer les informations publiques.

#### Preuves et témoignages

Skills: 5

[evidenceAndTestimony.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/evidenceAndTestimony.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Knowledge often depends on information supplied by other people or institutions. Source reliability, independence, and evidential fit require appraisal without treating every source as equally trustworthy.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à évaluer les affirmations et les preuves transmises par autrui.

##### Analyser l'injustice épistémique

[analyzeEpistemicInjustice.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/analyzeEpistemicInjustice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how prejudicial credibility judgments or unequal interpretive resources can wrong someone in their capacity as a knower, distinct from warranted critical assessment of testimony.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment des jugements injustes de crédibilité peuvent empêcher certaines personnes d'être entendues.

##### Vérifier la corroboration entre sources

[checkCorroborationAcrossSources.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/checkCorroborationAcrossSources.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether apparently agreeing accounts are genuinely independent or reproduce one underlying report.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Vérifie si plusieurs sources concordantes apportent réellement des preuves indépendantes.

##### Distinguer une affirmation de ses preuves

[distinguishAClaimFromItsEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/distinguishAClaimFromItsEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate what someone asserts from the observations, documents, or arguments presented to support it.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Sépare ce qui est affirmé des preuves présentées à l'appui.

##### Distinguer preuve directe et ouï-dire

[distinguishDirectEvidenceFromHearsay.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/distinguishDirectEvidenceFromHearsay.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize what a record or witness directly establishes and what depends on another person's retelling.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les traces de première main des affirmations répétées par d'autres.

##### Évaluer la crédibilité d'un témoignage

[evaluateTestimonialCredibility.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/evaluateTestimonialCredibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider the speaker's opportunity to know, relevant competence, track record, and possible conflicts without reducing evaluation to popularity.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue un témoin ou un expert selon son expérience pertinente et ses éventuels conflits d'intérêts.

#### Connaissance et justification

Skills: 5

[knowledgeAndJustification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/knowledgeAndJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Belief, truth, evidence, and knowledge have distinct roles in epistemic evaluation. Competing theories of knowledge can disagree about exactly how those roles connect.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment croyance, vérité, preuves et connaissance se relient tout en restant distinctes.

##### Analyser la preuve mathématique comme justification

[analyzeMathematicalProofAsJustification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/analyzeMathematicalProofAsJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine why deductive proof has a distinctive epistemic role in mathematics, distinguishing formal derivability from experimental confirmation and acknowledging debates about proof's explanatory value.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi une démonstration mathématique diffère des preuves recueillies par l'expérience.

##### Comparer justification a priori et justification empirique

[compareAPrioriAndEmpiricalJustification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/compareAPrioriAndEmpiricalJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish support based primarily on reasoning from support requiring experience, without assuming the boundary is universally uncontested.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les connaissances fondées sur le raisonnement à celles fondées sur l'expérience.

##### Distinguer croyance et connaissance

[distinguishBeliefFromKnowledge.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/distinguishBeliefFromKnowledge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that sincerely accepting a proposition does not by itself establish that it is known, even when the speaker is confident.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi croire sincèrement une affirmation ne suffit pas à en faire une connaissance.

##### Distinguer vérité et justification

[distinguishTruthFromJustification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/distinguishTruthFromJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a claim might be true for reasons its holder cannot supply, or well supported yet ultimately false.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue le fait qu'une affirmation soit vraie du fait d'avoir de bonnes raisons d'y croire.

##### Évaluer les raisons d'une croyance

[evaluateReasonsForABelief.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/evaluateReasonsForABelief.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether offered grounds actually bear on the proposition and withstand plausible objections.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Vérifie si les raisons avancées soutiennent réellement une croyance.

#### Médias et information publique

Skills: 5

[mediaAndPublicInformation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/mediaAndPublicInformation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Information environments combine reporting, interpretation, promotion, and falsehood. Epistemic evaluation concerns the warrant for public claims, not the psychological mechanics by which messages persuade audiences.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à examiner les reportages, les opinions et les affirmations diffusées publiquement.

##### Distinguer les fausses informations des accusations de tromperie volontaire

[distinguishMisinformationFromDeliberateDeceptionClaims.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/distinguishMisinformationFromDeliberateDeceptionClaims.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify inaccurate information without asserting an author's intention to deceive unless independent evidence supports that inference.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère les affirmations inexactes sans supposer que l'auteur voulait tromper.

##### Distinguer reportage et opinion

[distinguishReportingFromOpinion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/distinguishReportingFromOpinion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a passage presents checkable occurrences, interpretation, advocacy, or a mixture requiring separate evaluation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue le compte rendu factuel de l'interprétation et de la défense d'une position.

##### Évaluer les preuves derrière un titre

[evaluateEvidenceBehindAHeadline.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/evaluateEvidenceBehindAHeadline.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare a summary with the underlying article or evidence and identify claims that exceed what is documented.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare ce qu'annonce un titre aux preuves fournies dans le reportage.

##### Repérer un contexte trompeur dans les preuves

[recognizeMisleadingContextInPresentedEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/recognizeMisleadingContextInPresentedEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Detect how cropping, omitted baselines, selective examples, or missing dates can alter the apparent meaning of otherwise genuine material.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais comment des dates omises, des images recadrées ou un contexte absent peuvent tromper.

##### Remonter une affirmation publique à sa source initiale

[traceAPublicClaimToItsOriginalSource.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/traceAPublicClaimToItsOriginalSource.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Follow citations or reposts to determine what a primary document, recording, or dataset actually says.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Remonte à un document ou enregistrement original pour vérifier ce qu'il dit vraiment.

#### Incertitude et scepticisme

Skills: 4

[uncertaintyAndSkepticism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/uncertaintyAndSkepticism/uncertaintyAndSkepticism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Rational inquiry must accommodate incomplete evidence and the possibility of error without collapsing into indiscriminate doubt.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment raisonner avec prudence lorsque les preuves sont incomplètes.

##### Adapter sa confiance aux preuves

[calibrateConfidenceToEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/uncertaintyAndSkepticism/skills/calibrateConfidenceToEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Express degrees of certainty proportionate to the support available and identify what new information could change them.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Ajuste ton degré de certitude à propos d'une affirmation aux preuves disponibles.

##### Évaluer une objection sceptique

[evaluateASkepticalChallenge.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/uncertaintyAndSkepticism/skills/evaluateASkepticalChallenge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether a proposed possibility of error undermines a specific knowledge claim or sets an unrealistically absolute standard.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue si une objection sceptique remet réellement en cause une affirmation précise.

##### Repérer un désaccord sur les critères de preuve

[identifyADisagreementAboutEvidenceStandards.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/uncertaintyAndSkepticism/skills/identifyADisagreementAboutEvidenceStandards.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish people contesting a factual premise from people applying different thresholds for accepting the same evidence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère les désaccords sur les exigences de preuve, pas seulement sur les faits.

##### Reconnaître les limites de ses connaissances

[recognizeTheLimitsOfPersonalKnowledge.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/uncertaintyAndSkepticism/skills/recognizeTheLimitsOfPersonalKnowledge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differentiate what one has observed, inferred, learned from others, or cannot currently establish.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue ce que tu as observé de ce que tu as simplement déduit.

### Éthique et raisonnement moral

Groups: 5 · Skills: 25

[ethicsAndMoralReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicsAndMoralReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Ethics studies what ought to be done, what makes actions right or wrong, and how moral reasons apply to individuals and institutions. It evaluates normative standards rather than describing the psychological development of moral feelings.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore ce qui rend une action juste ou injuste et comment justifier les jugements moraux.

#### Éthique appliquée

Skills: 5

[appliedEthics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/appliedEthics/appliedEthics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Ethical principles face distinctive challenges when rights, vulnerable people, nonhuman life, and emerging technologies are involved.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les questions éthiques liées au consentement, à la vie privée, aux animaux, à la nature et à la technologie.

##### Évaluer le consentement dans une situation éthique

[evaluateConsentInAnEthicalScenario.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/appliedEthics/skills/evaluateConsentInAnEthicalScenario.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether a decision is adequately informed, voluntary, and within the decision-maker's authority.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Vérifie si le consentement est éclairé, libre et donné par la personne habilitée.

##### Évaluer les devoirs envers les animaux non humains

[evaluateDutiesTowardNonhumanAnimals.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/appliedEthics/skills/evaluateDutiesTowardNonhumanAnimals.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare grounds for considering animal welfare or moral status in choices that affect sentient beings.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine les raisons morales de prendre en compte le bien-être des animaux non humains.

##### Évaluer les obligations environnementales

[evaluateEnvironmentalObligations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/appliedEthics/skills/evaluateEnvironmentalObligations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine duties to ecosystems and future generations, including trade-offs between present and long-term interests.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les obligations envers les écosystèmes et les générations futures.

##### Évaluer les implications éthiques des décisions automatisées

[evaluateEthicalImplicationsOfAutomatedDecisions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/appliedEthics/skills/evaluateEthicalImplicationsOfAutomatedDecisions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess responsibility, contestability, fairness, and potential harm when an algorithm influences consequential choices.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue l'équité, la responsabilité et les risques de préjudice dans les décisions influencées par des algorithmes.

##### Évaluer la vie privée comme valeur éthique

[evaluatePrivacyAsAnEthicalValue.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/appliedEthics/skills/evaluatePrivacyAsAnEthicalValue.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reason about informational control, trust, and harms of disclosure beyond compliance with a particular law.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réfléchis à l'importance de la vie privée, au-delà des obligations légales.

#### Cadres éthiques

Skills: 5

[ethicalFrameworks.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/ethicalFrameworks.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Normative theories emphasize different criteria of moral assessment. A theory is not a universal formula that automatically resolves every difficult case.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les principales théories permettant d'évaluer les actions justes ou injustes.

##### Appliquer un raisonnement fondé sur l'éthique du care

[applyCareEthicalReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/skills/applyCareEthicalReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate obligations arising from dependence, relationships, vulnerability, and context without treating care as the absence of principles.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Prends en compte la vulnérabilité, les relations et le soin pour évaluer les obligations.

##### Appliquer un raisonnement conséquentialiste

[applyConsequentialistReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/skills/applyConsequentialistReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate an action by outcomes and the welfare or values its consequences affect, accounting for affected parties.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Prends en compte les conséquences probables et toutes les personnes concernées pour évaluer un choix.

##### Appliquer un raisonnement fondé sur le devoir

[applyDutyBasedReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/skills/applyDutyBasedReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether an act respects a rule, obligation, or person's standing even when violating it might have beneficial effects.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Juge une action à la lumière des devoirs et des droits ainsi que de ses conséquences.

##### Appliquer un raisonnement fondé sur l'éthique des vertus

[applyVirtueEthicalReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/skills/applyVirtueEthicalReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider the traits and practical judgment exemplified by an action rather than evaluating only isolated rules or outcomes.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Demande-toi ce qu'une action révèle du caractère et de la sagesse pratique.

##### Comparer les cadres éthiques face à un même dilemme

[compareEthicalFrameworksOnOneDilemma.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicalFrameworks/skills/compareEthicalFrameworksOnOneDilemma.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why distinct normative standards may support different recommendations even when the underlying facts are shared.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare comment différentes théories morales concluent face à un même dilemme.

#### Métaéthique

Skills: 6

[metaethics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/metaethics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Inquiry into the meaning, objectivity, and epistemic standing of moral discourse underlies but does not itself prescribe codes of conduct. Normative theories decide how to act; metaethical theories examine the status of such judgments.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore le sens des énoncés moraux et la question de savoir si les vérités morales dépendent des croyances personnelles.

##### Analyser le désaccord moral

[analyzeMoralDisagreement.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/skills/analyzeMoralDisagreement.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether disputants differ about facts, principles, or the status of moral claims, and what kinds of reasons could address those differences.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les désaccords sur les faits de ceux sur les normes morales.

##### Comparer réalisme et antiréalisme moral

[compareMoralRealismAndAntiRealism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/skills/compareMoralRealismAndAntiRealism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess opposing views about whether moral truths exist independently of attitudes, and distinguish this ontological disagreement from practical moral choices.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les positions qui affirment des vérités morales objectives avec celles qui les rejettent.

##### Distinguer questions métaéthiques et normatives

[distinguishMetaethicalFromNormativeQuestions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/skills/distinguishMetaethicalFromNormativeQuestions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate questions about which actions are right from questions about what moral claims mean and whether their truth is objective.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue la question de ce qui est juste de celle du sens des jugements moraux.

##### Distinguer cognitivisme et non-cognitivisme moral

[distinguishMoralCognitivismFromNonCognitivism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/skills/distinguishMoralCognitivismFromNonCognitivism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether moral utterances express truth-apt beliefs or instead function as prescriptions, commitments, or other attitudes.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore si les énoncés moraux décrivent des faits ou expriment des attitudes et engagements.

##### Évaluer le relativisme moral

[evaluateMoralRelativism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/skills/evaluateMoralRelativism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test the view that moral truth or justification varies by culture or individual against cases involving disagreement, criticism, and reform.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine si le bien et le mal dépendent de la culture ou du point de vue individuel.

##### Examiner la motivation morale

[examineMoralMotivation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/skills/examineMoralMotivation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare philosophical positions on whether sincerely judging an act right necessarily motivates someone to perform it, without substituting a psychological causal theory.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Demande-toi si croire qu'une chose est juste pousse nécessairement à agir.

#### Concepts moraux

Skills: 4

[moralConcepts.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/moralConcepts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Ethical claims use concepts such as duty, harm, intention, and virtue that cannot be reduced to personal approval.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à reconnaître des notions comme le devoir, l'intention, le tort et la responsabilité morale.

##### Analyser le devoir moral

[analyzeMoralDuty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/skills/analyzeMoralDuty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify what it means to hold that a person is obligated to act even when doing so is inconvenient.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi les obligations morales peuvent s'imposer même lorsqu'elles sont difficiles à remplir.

##### Distinguer intentions et conséquences

[distinguishIntentionsFromConsequences.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/skills/distinguishIntentionsFromConsequences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why an action's aim and its actual effects may be evaluated separately in moral reasoning.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue séparément l'objectif visé par une action et ses effets.

##### Distinguer jugements moraux et non moraux

[distinguishMoralFromNonMoralJudgments.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/skills/distinguishMoralFromNonMoralJudgments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when a claim concerns obligations or rights rather than taste, etiquette, prudence, or mere legality.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les jugements éthiques des goûts personnels, des règles de politesse et des lois.

##### Distinguer responsabilité morale et responsabilité causale

[distinguishMoralResponsibilityFromCausalResponsibility.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralConcepts/skills/distinguishMoralResponsibilityFromCausalResponsibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate causing an outcome from being appropriately accountable for it under relevant knowledge and control conditions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue le fait de causer quelque chose du fait de mériter un blâme moral.

#### Délibération morale

Skills: 5

[moralDeliberation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/moralDeliberation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Difficult cases require identifying who is affected, which reasons conflict, and whether an apparent compromise respects relevant obligations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à raisonner face à des choix difficiles où s'opposent plusieurs considérations éthiques.

##### Évaluer la proportionnalité des décisions morales

[assessProportionalityInMoralDecisions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/skills/assessProportionalityInMoralDecisions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider whether a harmful burden or restriction is justified in relation to its aim and less harmful alternatives.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue si les préjudices ou restrictions sont proportionnés à un objectif justifié.

##### Évaluer un contre-argument moral

[evaluateAMoralCounterargument.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/skills/evaluateAMoralCounterargument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test whether an objection exposes an overlooked harm, inconsistency, or relevant exception to a principle.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Considère les objections qui révèlent des torts, des exceptions ou des incohérences.

##### Identifier des obligations morales contradictoires

[identifyConflictingMoralObligations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/skills/identifyConflictingMoralObligations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Specify duties or values that cannot all be fully honored in a concrete case without assuming that all conflicts are irresolvable.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les cas où deux obligations éthiques ne peuvent pas être pleinement respectées ensemble.

##### Identifier les parties prenantes d'un dilemme éthique

[identifyStakeholdersInAnEthicalDilemma.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/skills/identifyStakeholdersInAnEthicalDilemma.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize persons or other morally relevant parties affected directly or indirectly by a proposed choice.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Identifie toutes les personnes et autres parties concernées par un choix moral.

##### Justifier un jugement moral

[justifyAMoralJudgment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/moralDeliberation/skills/justifyAMoralJudgment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect a normative conclusion to stated values, principles, and case facts rather than mere personal preference.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Appuie un jugement moral sur des principes explicites et des faits pertinents.

### Histoire et traditions de la philosophie

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Historically situated philosophical arguments develop through schools, intellectual movements, and traditions across cultures. Interpretation requires understanding both what a thinker argued and the debate that shaped the argument, without privileging one lineage as philosophy's default.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore des idées philosophiques de différentes cultures et époques à travers leurs arguments.

#### Traditions philosophiques

Skills: 8

[philosophicalTraditions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/philosophicalTraditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Intellectual traditions developed across many cultures through original arguments and sustained exchanges. Greek, Indian, Chinese, Islamic, African, Latin American, and particular Indigenous lineages are examined as philosophical sources in their own right, without treating a region as a single doctrine.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine les arguments philosophiques élaborés dans différentes traditions culturelles.

##### Analyser un argument d'une tradition philosophique chinoise

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAChineseTradition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAChineseTradition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a position in a specific Chinese philosophical lineage, such as Confucian or Daoist thinking, without conflating them.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Interprète une thèse d'une tradition chinoise dans son contexte propre.

##### Analyser un argument d'une tradition latino-américaine

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromALatinAmericanTradition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromALatinAmericanTradition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reconstruct an argument from a specific Latin American current, such as liberation or decolonial philosophy, in its intellectual and social context without reducing the region to one doctrine.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore des arguments latino-américains dans leur contexte social et intellectuel.

##### Analyser un argument d'une tradition africaine

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnAfricanTradition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnAfricanTradition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine a representative argument concerning persons, community, knowledge, or values while avoiding claims that Africa has a single philosophy.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Analyse un argument philosophique issu d'une tradition africaine particulière.

##### Analyser un argument d’une tradition philosophique indienne

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIndianTradition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIndianTradition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify claims and reasons in a specific Indian philosophical school while preserving its distinctive terms and internal disagreements.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore un argument d’une école philosophique indienne précise.

##### Analyser un argument d’une tradition philosophique autochtone

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIndigenousTradition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIndigenousTradition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret philosophical claims from a particular Indigenous people or intellectual tradition on their own conceptual terms, recognizing differences among communities and avoiding a generic 'Indigenous worldview'.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Considère les idées d’une tradition autochtone selon ses propres concepts.

##### Analyser un argument d’une tradition philosophique islamique

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIslamicTradition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIslamicTradition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain a selected debate in Islamic philosophy using its intellectual context rather than assuming theology and philosophy are identical.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine un débat de philosophie islamique dans son contexte historique.

##### Comparer les approches de la philosophie grecque classique

[compareClassicalGreekPhilosophicalApproaches.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/compareClassicalGreekPhilosophicalApproaches.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast representative methods or commitments in Socratic, Platonic, and Aristotelian arguments without collapsing them into one doctrine.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les idées de Socrate, Platon et Aristote.

##### Comparer des positions entre traditions philosophiques

[comparePositionsAcrossPhilosophicalTraditions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/comparePositionsAcrossPhilosophicalTraditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a genuine shared problem and meaningful conceptual differences without forcing one tradition's categories onto another.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare comment différentes traditions abordent des questions semblables.

#### Lire les œuvres philosophiques

Skills: 4

[readingPhilosophicalWorks.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/readingPhilosophicalWorks.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Texts require interpreting claims, their argumentative context, and the questions the author sought to answer; historical wording cannot always be mapped directly to modern categories.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à lire des œuvres philosophiques en tenant compte de leurs questions et de leur contexte.

##### Évaluer un texte philosophique de manière critique

[evaluateAPhilosophicalTextCritically.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/skills/evaluateAPhilosophicalTextCritically.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess reasons offered in a source rather than accepting or rejecting a view solely because of the author's reputation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue les raisons d’un texte classique, pas seulement la réputation de son auteur.

##### Identifier le problème central d’un texte philosophique

[identifyTheCentralProblemInAPhilosophicalText.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/skills/identifyTheCentralProblemInAPhilosophicalText.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine which issue motivates an argument rather than treating every illustrative passage as the main thesis.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère le problème principal qu’un philosophe cherche à traiter.

##### Interpréter un philosophe dans son contexte historique

[interpretAPhilosopherInHistoricalContext.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/skills/interpretAPhilosopherInHistoricalContext.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use contemporaneous debates and available concepts to avoid attributing later assumptions to an earlier author.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Interprète ses idées à la lumière des débats de son époque.

##### Reconstituer un argument philosophique historique

[reconstructAHistoricalPhilosophicalArgument.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/readingPhilosophicalWorks/skills/reconstructAHistoricalPhilosophicalArgument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Extract claims and reasons from a source while distinguishing a philosopher's stated position from later summaries.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconstitue l’argument à partir des écrits réels du philosophe.

#### Écoles et mouvements philosophiques

Skills: 3

[schoolsAndMovements.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/schoolsAndMovements/schoolsAndMovements.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Philosophical movements and schools arise around distinctive approaches to knowledge, reason, liberty, and existence; their boundaries and internal disagreements cannot be reduced to dates alone.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment différentes écoles philosophiques abordent des questions communes.

##### Analyser un argument philosophique des Lumières

[analyzeAnEnlightenmentPhilosophicalArgument.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/schoolsAndMovements/skills/analyzeAnEnlightenmentPhilosophicalArgument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Place a claim about reason, liberty, or authority in its intellectual context while acknowledging diverse and conflicting Enlightenment positions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les arguments des Lumières sur la raison, l’autorité et la liberté.

##### Comparer approches existentialistes et analytiques

[compareExistentialistAndAnalyticApproachesToAProblem.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/schoolsAndMovements/skills/compareExistentialistAndAnalyticApproachesToAProblem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify differences in methods and questions without claiming that either broad family has one uniform answer.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les deux approches sans simplifier excessivement l’une ou l’autre.

##### Comparer les grandes approches modernes de l’épistémologie

[compareMajorModernEpistemologicalApproaches.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/schoolsAndMovements/skills/compareMajorModernEpistemologicalApproaches.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the distinct emphases of rationalist, empiricist, and critical traditions through representative arguments.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare comment rationalisme, empirisme et philosophie critique abordent la connaissance.

### Logique et argumentation

Groups: 6 · Skills: 35

[logicAndArgumentation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/logicAndArgumentation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The central question is whether reasons support a conclusion and in what way. Formal entailment, defeasible inference, and argumentative defects are distinguished from psychological causes of belief, which belong chiefly to Psychology.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à évaluer si des raisons soutiennent une conclusion et à repérer les raisonnements fautifs.

#### Sophismes argumentatifs

Skills: 6

[argumentativeFallacies.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/argumentativeFallacies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A flaw concerns the relation between claims and reasons, not necessarily the speaker's motives or a named cognitive bias. Context matters: surface wording alone rarely proves fallaciousness.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à reconnaître les défauts courants des raisons avancées pour soutenir des thèses.

##### Repérer un faux dilemme

[detectAFalseDilemma.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/skills/detectAFalseDilemma.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a purported exhaustive choice that overlooks meaningful alternatives or combined possibilities.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Trouve les possibilités pertinentes cachées par un choix trompeur entre deux seules options.

##### Repérer l'argument de l'homme de paille

[detectAStrawManArgument.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/skills/detectAStrawManArgument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show where a position is distorted into an easier target and recover the actual view before evaluating it.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère quand la position d'une personne est déformée pour être plus facile à attaquer.

##### Repérer un sophisme ad hominem

[detectAnAdHominemFallacy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/skills/detectAnAdHominemFallacy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when a personal attack substitutes for addressing reasons, while distinguishing relevant credibility evidence from irrelevant insults.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère quand une attaque personnelle remplace un raisonnement pertinent.

##### Repérer un sophisme d'équivoque

[detectAnEquivocationFallacy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/skills/detectAnEquivocationFallacy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace a shift between meanings of the same expression that makes an inference appear stronger than it is.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère quand le sens d'un mot change au cours d'un argument.

##### Repérer un raisonnement circulaire

[detectCircularReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/skills/detectCircularReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize when the offered support presupposes the very claim at issue without independent justification.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère les arguments qui supposent déjà vraie la conclusion qu'ils prétendent démontrer.

##### Évaluer un appel à l'autorité

[evaluateAnAppealToAuthority.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/skills/evaluateAnAppealToAuthority.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether expertise is relevant and reliable evidence in context, rather than assuming that invoking any authority proves a conclusion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Détermine si l'expertise citée est un indice pertinent plutôt qu'une preuve automatique.

#### Arguments et inférence

Skills: 4

[argumentsAndInference.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentsAndInference/argumentsAndInference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Arguments connect propositions through an inferential claim; assertions, explanations, and rhetorical appeals may occur nearby without playing the same role.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les prémisses et la conclusion forment un argument.

##### Distinguer un argument d'une explication

[distinguishAnArgumentFromAnExplanation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentsAndInference/skills/distinguishAnArgumentFromAnExplanation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Tell reasoning intended to establish a claim from an account of why an already accepted event or fact occurred.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue une raison de croire quelque chose d'une explication d'un fait admis.

##### Repérer la conclusion d'un argument

[identifyAnArgumentsConclusion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentsAndInference/skills/identifyAnArgumentsConclusion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine which proposition is supposed to follow or gain support, regardless of its position in a passage.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère la thèse centrale qu'un argument cherche à établir.

##### Repérer les prémisses d'un argument

[identifyPremisesInAnArgument.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentsAndInference/skills/identifyPremisesInAnArgument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locate the reasons offered in support of a conclusion, including unstated propositions when context makes them indispensable.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Trouve les énoncés proposés comme raisons à l'appui d'une affirmation.

##### Reconstituer un argument sous forme standard

[reconstructAnArgumentInStandardForm.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentsAndInference/skills/reconstructAnArgumentInStandardForm.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Arrange its relevant premises and conclusion explicitly while preserving the original reasoning rather than improving it silently.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réécris un argument avec des prémisses claires suivies de sa conclusion.

#### Raisonnement déductif

Skills: 6

[deductiveReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/deductiveReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Deduction concerns whether it is possible for premises to be true while a conclusion is false. Logical form is evaluated separately from whether the premises describe the world correctly.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore quand une conclusion découle nécessairement des prémisses données.

##### Appliquer le modus ponens

[applyModusPonens.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/applyModusPonens.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer a consequent from a conditional and its antecedent without treating the inverse conditional as equivalent.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Applique la règle : si A implique B et si A est vrai, alors B suit.

##### Appliquer le modus tollens

[applyModusTollens.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/applyModusTollens.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reject the antecedent of a conditional from the denial of its consequent, under the conditional as stated.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise une condition et la négation de son conséquent pour rejeter l'antécédent.

##### Évaluer la validité déductive

[assessDeductiveValidity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/assessDeductiveValidity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether a conclusion must hold if the premises hold, using logical structure rather than agreement with the conclusion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Vérifie si les prémisses pourraient toutes être vraies alors que la conclusion serait fausse.

##### Distinguer validité et solidité

[distinguishValidityFromSoundness.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/distinguishValidityFromSoundness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a sound deductive argument requires both a valid inference and true premises.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi un argument logiquement valide peut comporter des prémisses fausses.

##### Évaluer un syllogisme catégorique

[evaluateACategoricalSyllogism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/evaluateACategoricalSyllogism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether relations among classes support the proposed conclusion, rather than relying on familiar subject matter.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Détermine si des énoncés sur des catégories soutiennent logiquement une conclusion.

##### Repérer une contradiction entre plusieurs affirmations

[identifyAContradictionInASetOfClaims.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/deductiveReasoning/skills/identifyAContradictionInASetOfClaims.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show where commitments cannot all be true together under the same meanings and conditions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère des affirmations qui ne peuvent pas toutes être vraies dans les mêmes conditions.

#### Raisonnement non déductif

Skills: 4

[nonDeductiveReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/nonDeductiveReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Many reasonable arguments support conclusions without guaranteeing them. Their strength depends on evidence, alternatives, sampling, or explanatory power rather than formal certainty.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à évaluer un raisonnement qui soutient une conclusion sans garantir sa certitude.

##### Distinguer certitude déductive et soutien probabiliste

[distinguishDeductiveCertaintyFromProbabilisticSupport.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/skills/distinguishDeductiveCertaintyFromProbabilisticSupport.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a well-supported conclusion can remain revisable when the reasoning is non-deductive.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les déductions logiquement certaines des conclusions soutenues par une probabilité.

##### Évaluer une généralisation inductive

[evaluateAnInductiveGeneralization.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/skills/evaluateAnInductiveGeneralization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Judge how well observed cases support a claim about a broader population, including the relevance of selection and variation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue dans quelle mesure les exemples observés justifient une généralisation plus large.

##### Évaluer l'inférence à la meilleure explication

[evaluateAnInferenceToTheBestExplanation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/skills/evaluateAnInferenceToTheBestExplanation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare hypotheses by how well they explain evidence, their assumptions, and their fit with alternative explanations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Choisis entre des explications possibles selon les preuves et les hypothèses.

##### Évaluer un raisonnement par analogie

[evaluateAnalogicalReasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/nonDeductiveReasoning/skills/evaluateAnalogicalReasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Check whether compared cases share features relevant to the proposed conclusion rather than merely superficial similarities.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare des cas selon les ressemblances réellement pertinentes pour la conclusion.

#### Logique des prédicats

Skills: 6

[predicateLogic.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/predicateLogic.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Variables and quantifiers permit reasoning about individuals and collections. The relevant universe and scope of each quantifier must be made explicit to evaluate meaning and inference.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les quantificateurs expriment des affirmations sur tous ou certains membres d'un groupe.

##### Analyser la portée d'un quantificateur

[analyzeTheScopeOfAQuantifier.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/skills/analyzeTheScopeOfAQuantifier.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify which variables and expressions are governed by a quantifier and how scope changes the meaning of a formula.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais comment la position d'un quantificateur change le sens d'un énoncé.

##### Distinguer prédicats et propositions

[distinguishPredicatesFromPropositions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/skills/distinguishPredicatesFromPropositions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize a predicate with an unbound variable as an open expression and a proposition as a statement with specified truth conditions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue une expression ouverte avec une variable d'une proposition complète.

##### Évaluer une inférence avec quantificateurs

[evaluateAnInferenceWithQuantifiers.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/skills/evaluateAnInferenceWithQuantifiers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Check whether a conclusion about all or some members of a domain follows from quantified premises under a stated interpretation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Vérifie si des prémisses quantifiées impliquent réellement la conclusion proposée.

##### Interpréter la quantification existentielle

[interpretExistentialQuantification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/skills/interpretExistentialQuantification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine what it means for at least one element of a specified domain to satisfy a property, without implying uniqueness.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends que « il existe » signifie qu'au moins un élément répond à la condition.

##### Interpréter la quantification universelle

[interpretUniversalQuantification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/skills/interpretUniversalQuantification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine what it means for a property to hold for every element of a specified domain and how one counterexample would matter.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends un énoncé qui s'applique à chaque membre d'un groupe défini.

##### Nier une proposition quantifiée

[negateAQuantifiedProposition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/predicateLogic/skills/negateAQuantifiedProposition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the relationships between not-all and some-not, and between none and there-exists, to interpret negation accurately.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Nie des énoncés contenant « tous » ou « certains » sans déformer leur sens.

#### Logique propositionnelle

Skills: 9

[propositionalLogic.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/propositionalLogic.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Truth-functional connections between propositions determine the logical properties of compound statements. Symbolic operators and truth tables clarify implications independent of the subject matter used in examples.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre les conditions de vérité des énoncés reliés par des opérateurs logiques.

##### Classer une proposition avec une table de vérité

[classifyAPropositionUsingATruthTable.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/classifyAPropositionUsingATruthTable.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish tautological, contradictory, and contingent expressions through their truth values under all assignments.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise les tables de vérité pour distinguer les énoncés toujours vrais, toujours faux et contingents.

##### Construire une table de vérité

[constructATruthTable.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/constructATruthTable.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Enumerate truth-value combinations for atomic propositions and systematically compute outcomes of logical expressions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Construis une table des valeurs de vérité possibles d'une expression logique.

##### Distinguer propositions atomiques et composées

[distinguishAtomicFromCompoundPropositions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/distinguishAtomicFromCompoundPropositions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A proposition can stand alone or form part of a statement built with logical connectives; truth-functional structure differs from the number of words in an ordinary sentence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue une proposition simple d'une proposition formée de connecteurs logiques.

##### Interpréter l'équivalence logique

[interpretLogicalBiconditional.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/interpretLogicalBiconditional.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess 'if and only if' statements as two-way conditional relationships, rather than treating either one-way conditional as sufficient.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais que « si et seulement si » exige une implication dans les deux sens.

##### Interpréter la conjonction logique

[interpretLogicalConjunction.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/interpretLogicalConjunction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the truth conditions of logical 'and' while distinguishing conjunction from a chronological or causal relationship.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand une proposition avec le « et » logique est vraie.

##### Interpréter la disjonction logique

[interpretLogicalDisjunction.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/interpretLogicalDisjunction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the truth conditions of inclusive 'or' and distinguish these from interpretations that require exactly one alternative.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Interprète le « ou » inclusif sans supposer qu'une seule option peut être vraie.

##### Interpréter la négation logique

[interpretLogicalNegation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/interpretLogicalNegation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine when the denial of a proposition is true and distinguish negation from a stronger contrary statement.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment nier une affirmation change ses conditions de vérité.

##### Interpréter l'implication matérielle

[interpretMaterialImplication.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/interpretMaterialImplication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine when a conditional is true in classical propositional logic without confusing logical implication with causation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends quand une conditionnelle est vraie en logique propositionnelle classique.

##### Tester la validité déductive avec une table de vérité

[testDeductiveValidityUsingATruthTable.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/propositionalLogic/skills/testDeductiveValidityUsingATruthTable.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Search for a case in which all premises are true but the conclusion false to determine propositional validity.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Teste une déduction en cherchant un cas où les prémisses sont vraies et la conclusion fausse.

### Métaphysique

Groups: 4 · Skills: 14

[metaphysics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/metaphysics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Metaphysics examines the most general categories of reality, such as what exists, how things persist, and what makes events possible. Its conceptual questions differ from describing particular natural mechanisms in the sciences.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les questions philosophiques sur l'existence, l'identité, la réalité, le temps et le possible.

#### Causalité, temps et possibilité

Skills: 4

[causationTimeAndPossibility.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/causationTimeAndPossibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Metaphysical inquiry asks what causal dependence means and how temporal or modal claims relate beyond specific measurements.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine des idées philosophiques sur les causes, le temps et ce qui aurait pu arriver.

##### Comparer les conceptions philosophiques du temps

[comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfTime.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/skills/comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain differences between views that privilege the present and views treating past, present, and future as equally real.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare l'idée que seul le présent existe à celle où tous les temps sont réels.

##### Distinguer causalité et succession temporelle

[distinguishCausationFromTemporalSuccession.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/skills/distinguishCausationFromTemporalSuccession.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that one event occurring before another does not itself establish a productive or counterfactual dependence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Un événement antérieur n'est pas forcément la cause d'un événement ultérieur.

##### Distinguer possibilité et nécessité

[distinguishPossibilityFromNecessity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/skills/distinguishPossibilityFromNecessity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify claims that could be otherwise and those held to be true in every relevant possible circumstance.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue ce qui pourrait arriver de ce qui doit nécessairement être vrai.

##### Évaluer une affirmation contrefactuelle

[evaluateACounterfactualClaim.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/skills/evaluateACounterfactualClaim.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine what would follow if specified conditions had differed while keeping relevant background assumptions coherent.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue ce qui pourrait suivre si les conditions avaient été différentes.

#### Existence et catégories

Skills: 3

[existenceAndCategories.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/existenceAndCategories/existenceAndCategories.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Different theories posit concrete objects, properties, events, or abstract entities; their classification determines what kinds of ontological commitments a claim makes.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine les différents types de choses que les philosophes considèrent réelles.

##### Distinguer entités concrètes et abstraites

[distinguishConcreteFromAbstractEntities.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/existenceAndCategories/skills/distinguishConcreteFromAbstractEntities.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether a proposed entity has spatial or causal features characteristic of concrete things or is treated as abstract, such as a mathematical object.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les objets physiques des entités telles que les nombres ou les idées abstraites.

##### Distinguer propriétés et objets

[distinguishPropertiesFromObjects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/existenceAndCategories/skills/distinguishPropertiesFromObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate a bearer from qualities attributed to it, while recognizing that some metaphysical theories analyze this distinction differently.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue un objet des propriétés qu'on lui attribue.

##### Évaluer une affirmation d'existence

[evaluateAnExistenceClaim.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/existenceAndCategories/skills/evaluateAnExistenceClaim.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine the criteria by which something is said to exist rather than assuming that naming it settles its ontological status.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Demande-toi quelles preuves ou quels raisonnements soutiennent qu'une chose existe.

#### Identité et persistance

Skills: 4

[identityAndPersistence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/identityAndPersistence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Questions about sameness arise when material, properties, or relations change over time. Numerical identity is different from merely sharing characteristics.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Demande-toi ce qui fait qu'une chose demeure la même malgré le changement.

##### Analyser un paradoxe métaphysique

[analyzeAMetaphysicalParadox.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/skills/analyzeAMetaphysicalParadox.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify apparently plausible assumptions that generate inconsistent conclusions in a puzzle about reality.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère les hypothèses contradictoires dans une énigme sur la nature du réel.

##### Analyser la relation entre partie et tout

[analyzeAPartWholeRelation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/skills/analyzeAPartWholeRelation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether a component and a composite have different identities and what changes follow from replacing parts.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les parties d'un objet se rapportent à l'ensemble qu'elles composent.

##### Distinguer identité numérique et qualitative

[distinguishNumericalFromQualitativeIdentity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/skills/distinguishNumericalFromQualitativeIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the difference between being one and the same entity and being indistinguishable in specified properties.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue être exactement le même objet d'une simple ressemblance parfaite.

##### Évaluer la persistance à travers le changement

[evaluatePersistenceThroughChange.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/identityAndPersistence/skills/evaluatePersistenceThroughChange.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess competing criteria for when an object remains the same despite replacement, growth, or alteration.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Demande-toi si le remplacement de parties change l'identité d'un objet.

#### Réalité mathématique

Skills: 3

[mathematicalReality.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/mathematicalReality/mathematicalReality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Philosophical accounts of mathematics disagree over whether its objects exist independently, are constructs of formal language, or are positions within structures. These ontological commitments are distinct from learning to perform mathematical operations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore le débat sur l'existence des objets mathématiques indépendamment des humains.

##### Analyser le structuralisme mathématique

[analyzeMathematicalStructuralism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/mathematicalReality/skills/analyzeMathematicalStructuralism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the claim that mathematical objects are understood through positions and relations in structures rather than through individually identifying intrinsic properties.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore si les objets mathématiques se comprennent mieux par leurs relations.

##### Évaluer le nominalisme mathématique

[evaluateMathematicalNominalism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/mathematicalReality/skills/evaluateMathematicalNominalism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine strategies for understanding mathematical language and successful reasoning without committing to independently existing abstract mathematical objects.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Étudie comment le raisonnement mathématique fonctionnerait sans objets abstraits indépendants.

##### Évaluer le platonisme mathématique

[evaluateMathematicalPlatonism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/mathematicalReality/skills/evaluateMathematicalPlatonism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the view that mathematical objects or structures exist independently of human thought and how it attempts to explain the apparent objectivity of mathematics.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine les arguments selon lesquels les entités mathématiques existent indépendamment de l'esprit humain.

### Esprit, soi et existence humaine

Groups: 4 · Skills: 17

[mindSelfAndHumanExistence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindSelfAndHumanExistence.data.ts)
