**Methodological description (English):** Questions about subjective experience, the continuity of the self, deliberate action, and a meaningful human life cannot be resolved solely through psychological measurement. This domain examines theories of mind, identity, agency, and existential commitments, distinguishing them from empirical mental-health claims.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les questions philosophiques sur la conscience, l'identité personnelle, la liberté et le sens de la vie.

#### Capacité d'agir et libre arbitre

Skills: 5

[agencyAndFreeWill.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/agencyAndFreeWill.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Acting for reasons, selecting among alternatives, and being accountable are connected but separable philosophical ideas.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les liens entre choix, raisons, responsabilité et liberté.

##### Comparer liberté compatibiliste et incompatibiliste

[compareCompatibilistAndIncompatibilistFreedom.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/skills/compareCompatibilistAndIncompatibilistFreedom.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether meaningful free action is possible under determinism and how rival views define freedom.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine si liberté et responsabilité peuvent coexister avec le déterminisme.

##### Comparer déterminisme et indéterminisme

[compareDeterminismAndIndeterminism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/skills/compareDeterminismAndIndeterminism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the different claims about how events are determined and why randomness alone does not establish control.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare un monde entièrement déterminé à un monde où des événements indéterminés sont possibles.

##### Distinguer une action d'un événement

[distinguishAnActionFromAnEvent.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/skills/distinguishAnActionFromAnEvent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a description invokes an agent's intention or reason rather than only something that happened to a body.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue une action intentionnelle de quelque chose qui arrive simplement.

##### Distinguer raisons d'agir et causes du comportement

[distinguishReasonsForActionFromCausesOfBehavior.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/skills/distinguishReasonsForActionFromCausesOfBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate justifying considerations from causal explanations, recognizing that the two may be related.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les raisons qui justifient une action des causes qui expliquent un comportement.

##### Évaluer les conditions de responsabilité morale

[evaluateConditionsOfMoralResponsibility.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/agencyAndFreeWill/skills/evaluateConditionsOfMoralResponsibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider knowledge, control, intention, and coercion in judging whether blame or praise is warranted.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réfléchis aux connaissances et à la maîtrise nécessaires pour être moralement responsable.

#### Existence humaine et sens

Skills: 4

[humanExistenceAndMeaning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/humanExistenceAndMeaning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Existential reflection examines how people understand purpose, authenticity, finitude, and commitments, without prescribing a single life ideal or substituting for mental-health care.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les approches philosophiques d'une vie pleine de sens et authentique.

##### Analyser l'authenticité comme concept philosophique

[analyzeAuthenticityAsAPhilosophicalConcept.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/skills/analyzeAuthenticityAsAPhilosophicalConcept.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate competing claims about acting from one's commitments, social expectations, and self-understanding.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore si agir de façon authentique suppose de s'affranchir des attentes sociales.

##### Analyser la portée philosophique de la mortalité

[analyzeThePhilosophicalSignificanceOfMortality.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/skills/analyzeThePhilosophicalSignificanceOfMortality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how finitude affects arguments about priorities and meaning rather than making predictions about an individual's emotional response.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réfléchis à la manière dont la mortalité humaine influe sur les arguments concernant les priorités de la vie.

##### Comparer les conceptions philosophiques du sens de la vie

[comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfMeaningInLife.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/skills/comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfMeaningInLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast accounts that ground human meaning in relationships, achievement, self-authorship, transcendence, religious commitments, or nonreligious purposes, assessing their philosophical reasons without requiring adherence to any worldview.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare différentes idées sur ce qui donne du sens à la vie humaine.

##### Distinguer un but de vie d'une préférence passagère

[distinguishALifePurposeFromAPassingPreference.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/humanExistenceAndMeaning/skills/distinguishALifePurposeFromAPassingPreference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how sustained commitments and values differ from momentary wants when evaluating an account of a meaningful life.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les engagements de vie durables des envies du moment.

#### Esprit et conscience

Skills: 4

[mindAndConsciousness.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/mindAndConsciousness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A first-person experience and a third-person physical description offer different perspectives on mental life. Philosophical theories disagree about how these perspectives relate.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre différentes manières de comprendre l'expérience subjective et l'esprit.

##### Analyser un problème philosophique de conscience artificielle

[analyzeAPhilosophicalProblemOfArtificialConsciousness.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalProblemOfArtificialConsciousness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess what would and would not count as evidence of experience in an artificial system, without claiming a settled test exists.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réfléchis aux preuves qui pourraient étayer une affirmation sur la conscience artificielle.

##### Comparer les théories du rapport corps-esprit

[compareTheoriesOfTheMindBodyRelation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/compareTheoriesOfTheMindBodyRelation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast representative views such as physicalism and dualism by their commitments and explanatory challenges.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les explications philosophiques des liens entre l'esprit et le corps.

##### Distinguer descriptions mentales et physiques

[distinguishMentalFromPhysicalDescriptions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/distinguishMentalFromPhysicalDescriptions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when a claim describes subjective experience, observable behavior, or bodily processes, and why they are not automatically equivalent.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les descriptions de sentiments de celles des processus physiques cérébraux.

##### Expliquer le problème des autres esprits

[explainTheProblemOfOtherMinds.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/explainTheProblemOfOtherMinds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe why another being's subjective experiences are not observed in the same way as one's own, and what kinds of inferences are used.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Demande-toi comment savoir si un autre être a des expériences subjectives.

#### Identité personnelle

Skills: 4

[personalIdentity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/personalIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The self may be characterized by bodily, psychological, narrative, or relational continuity. The question is what makes someone the same person, not how memory works empirically.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore ce qui fait qu'une personne reste la même malgré les changements au fil du temps.

##### Analyser un critère de personnalité morale

[analyzeAPersonhoodCriterion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/analyzeAPersonhoodCriterion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test a proposed condition of being a person against borderline cases without assigning anyone lesser real-world dignity.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Mets à l'épreuve les critères du statut de personne face à des cas difficiles, sans nier la dignité humaine.

##### Comparer les théories de continuité corporelle et psychologique

[compareBodilyAndPsychologicalContinuityAccounts.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/compareBodilyAndPsychologicalContinuityAccounts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how different criteria handle change, memory loss, and hypothetical transfer scenarios.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les conceptions de l'identité personnelle fondées sur le corps ou la psychologie.

##### Distinguer identité personnelle et ressemblance

[distinguishPersonalIdentityFromSimilarity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/distinguishPersonalIdentityFromSimilarity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why sharing a personality or appearance is not enough to establish that two persons are numerically identical.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi deux personnes semblables ne sont pas nécessairement une seule et même personne.

##### Évaluer le rôle de la mémoire dans l'identité personnelle

[evaluateTheRoleOfMemoryInPersonalIdentity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/evaluateTheRoleOfMemoryInPersonalIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine the philosophical significance and limitations of remembered experience as a criterion of persistence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine si les souvenirs suffisent à établir la continuité d'une personne.

### Enquête philosophique

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[philosophicalInquiry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/philosophicalInquiry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Philosophy investigates conceptual, normative, and foundational questions whose answers require reasons rather than observation alone. This domain concerns the practices used to formulate, refine, and discuss such questions; it is distinct from the formal evaluation of arguments in Logic.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore des questions de sens, de valeurs et de présupposés grâce à une discussion argumentée.

#### Analyse conceptuelle

Skills: 4

[conceptualAnalysis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/conceptualAnalysis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Careful discussion depends on tracking the boundaries of concepts, especially when ordinary words cover multiple cases. These abilities refine meanings rather than merely memorize technical vocabulary.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment des définitions claires et des exemples bien choisis améliorent la réflexion philosophique.

##### Clarifier un concept controversé

[clarifyAContestedConcept.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/clarifyAContestedConcept.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Specify relevant conditions or uses of a term such as freedom so interlocutors can determine what their disagreement concerns.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Clarifie le sens d'un terme lorsque les personnes ne s'accordent pas sur son usage.

##### Distinguer conditions nécessaires et suffisantes

[distinguishNecessaryFromSufficientConditions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/distinguishNecessaryFromSufficientConditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether a proposed property is required for a concept to apply, enough for it to apply, or both; a condition can fail one test and pass the other.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Détermine si une condition est nécessaire, suffisante, les deux ou aucune des deux.

##### Tester une définition par un contre-exemple

[testADefinitionWithACounterexample.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/testADefinitionWithACounterexample.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Find a case included or excluded incorrectly by a proposed definition and explain what the case reveals about its limits.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Remets en question une définition en trouvant un cas qu'elle classe mal.

##### Examiner un concept par une expérience de pensée

[useAThoughtExperimentToExamineAConcept.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/useAThoughtExperimentToExamineAConcept.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Vary features of an imagined situation to isolate a philosophical principle; make clear which assumptions are stipulated rather than observed.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise une situation imaginaire pour éprouver une idée tout en précisant ses hypothèses.

#### Dialogue et désaccord

Skills: 4

[dialogueAndDisagreement.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/dialogueAndDisagreement.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reasoned dialogue seeks understanding and justified revision, not simply winning assent. Participants must fairly represent alternatives and keep interpersonal respect separate from agreement.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment un désaccord respectueux nous aide à reconsidérer nos idées.

##### Poser une question philosophique approfondie

[askAProbingPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/askAProbingPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Request a reason, distinction, implication, or counterexample that can advance inquiry without demanding personal disclosure.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Pose une question qui examine les raisons d'autrui ou clarifie son point de vue.

##### Reformuler équitablement la position d'autrui

[reconstructAnotherPersonsPositionFairly.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/reconstructAnotherPersonsPositionFairly.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Restate an interlocutor's strongest contextually plausible position accurately and charitably, rather than attacking a weaker caricature; fair reconstruction does not require overlooking genuine contradictions or unsupported claims.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reformule fidèlement la position d'autrui avant de la critiquer.

##### Répondre à une objection philosophique

[respondToAPhilosophicalObjection.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/respondToAPhilosophicalObjection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Address the actual challenge to a claim, rather than diverting to the objector's identity or motives.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réponds au fond d'une objection plutôt que d'attaquer la personne qui la formule.

##### Réviser une position à la lumière des raisons

[reviseAPositionInLightOfReasons.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/reviseAPositionInLightOfReasons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify which premise or conclusion should change when a cogent objection defeats an earlier commitment.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Modifie une croyance ou un argument quand une meilleure raison montre qu'il faut le revoir.

#### Questions et problèmes

Skills: 4

[questionsAndProblems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/questionsAndProblems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A productive philosophical problem can be examined through competing answers, explicit concepts, and reasons. The object is to make a question discussable without assuming that every question has a single empirical test.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à transformer des idées déroutantes en questions à discuter avec réflexion.

##### Distinguer un problème philosophique d'un exemple

[distinguishAPhilosophicalProblemFromAnExample.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/distinguishAPhilosophicalProblemFromAnExample.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate the general issue, such as whether promises create obligations, from the particular story used to make it vivid.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue un problème philosophique général du récit qui l'illustre.

##### Distinguer questions philosophiques et empiriques

[distinguishPhilosophicalQuestionsFromEmpiricalQuestions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/distinguishPhilosophicalQuestionsFromEmpiricalQuestions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when an issue asks what a concept means, what ought to be done, or what ultimately explains something, rather than only requesting a measurable fact; many questions have both aspects.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais ce qui distingue les questions philosophiques des questions auxquelles répond la mesure.

##### Formuler une question philosophique

[formulateAPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/formulateAPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Turn an ordinary puzzlement into an open question about meaning, reasons, values, or assumptions that admits more than a yes-or-no preference.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Pose une question ouverte sur les raisons, le sens ou les valeurs plutôt que sur une simple préférence.

##### Repérer les présupposés d'un problème philosophique

[identifyAssumptionsInAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/identifyAssumptionsInAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Expose propositions that a question or proposed answer takes for granted, such as what counts as a person or what makes an action fair.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Trouve les présupposés cachés derrière une question philosophique ou une réponse proposée.

### Philosophie du langage

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[philosophyOfLanguage.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/philosophyOfLanguage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Language is examined as a system for conveying meaning, referring to the world, performing actions, and shaping interpretation. Grammar instruction and literary composition remain primarily in Language and Literature.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les mots transmettent un sens, désignent des choses et façonnent la compréhension.

#### Communication et interprétation

Skills: 3

[communicationAndInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/communicationAndInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** What a speaker says can differ from what a speaker conveys or does by saying it. Interpretation must take context and plausible alternatives into account.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment le contexte influence ce que les gens disent et communiquent.

##### Distinguer sens littéral et sous-entendu

[distinguishLiteralMeaningFromImplication.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/skills/distinguishLiteralMeaningFromImplication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify content explicitly expressed versus a reasonable conversational inference that could be cancelled or revised.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue le sens littéral d'un énoncé de ce qu'il suggère.

##### Évaluer des interprétations contextuelles

[evaluateContextualInterpretations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/skills/evaluateContextualInterpretations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare readings of an utterance using the speaker's context, conventions, and available evidence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Choisis entre plusieurs interprétations en tenant compte du contexte et des preuves disponibles.

##### Identifier un acte de langage

[identifyASpeechAct.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/skills/identifyASpeechAct.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize how an utterance functions as a promise, request, warning, or assertion beyond its sentence structure.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand dire quelque chose accomplit une action, comme promettre ou demander.

#### Langage, vérité et pouvoir

Skills: 4

[languageTruthAndPower.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/languageTruthAndPower.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Descriptive categories, framing, and public speech influence which interpretations appear available. Evaluating their justification differs from explaining psychological persuasion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment le langage exprime des jugements et façonne le débat public.

##### Analyser un choix de cadrage

[analyzeAFramingChoice.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/analyzeAFramingChoice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how alternate labels foreground different aspects of one issue and test what evidence each framing leaves out.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les termes qui mettent en avant différents aspects d'un même problème.

##### Analyser un énoncé selon ses conditions de vérité

[analyzeATruthConditionalClaim.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/analyzeATruthConditionalClaim.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify circumstances under which an assertion would count as true or false while recognizing context-dependent expressions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Détermine les circonstances dans lesquelles une affirmation serait vraie ou fausse.

##### Distinguer langage descriptif et évaluatif

[distinguishDescriptiveFromEvaluativeLanguage.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/distinguishDescriptiveFromEvaluativeLanguage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how apparently factual wording can also express approval, disapproval, or a contested standard.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand une formulation apparemment factuelle exprime aussi un jugement.

##### Évaluer une affirmation sur la représentation linguistique

[evaluateAClaimAboutLinguisticRepresentation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/evaluateAClaimAboutLinguisticRepresentation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether a label fairly describes people or phenomena without equating linguistic conventions with objective essences.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine si les descriptions des personnes et des choses sont justes et bien étayées.

#### Sens et référence

Skills: 3

[meaningAndReference.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/meaningAndReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Words and sentences can express meanings beyond identifying objects; context, concepts, and the distinction between expression and referent affect analysis.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre la différence entre un mot, son sens et ce qu'il désigne.

##### Distinguer un mot de son référent

[distinguishAWordFromItsReferent.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/skills/distinguishAWordFromItsReferent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a linguistic expression and the person, object, or kind it denotes are not identical.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue un mot de la chose ou de la personne qu'il nomme.

##### Distinguer sens et référence

[distinguishSenseFromReference.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/skills/distinguishSenseFromReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how different expressions can pick out the same entity while presenting it in different ways.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais comment différentes expressions peuvent désigner la même entité de manières distinctes.

##### Repérer une ambiguïté sémantique

[identifySemanticAmbiguity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/skills/identifySemanticAmbiguity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize when a sentence admits multiple readings due to a word or syntactic structure rather than simply lacking evidence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Trouve des phrases qui peuvent avoir plusieurs sens.

### Philosophie de la religion

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[philosophyOfReligion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/philosophyOfReligion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reasoned inquiry into religious and nonreligious worldviews considers ultimate explanations, sources of belief, conceptions of divinity, and coexistence under pluralism. This domain evaluates arguments without prescribing worship, faith, atheism, or other personal commitments.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les arguments concernant les visions religieuses et non religieuses du monde, sans imposer de croyance.

#### Diversité et sens

Skills: 3

[diversityAndMeaning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/diversityAndMeaning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Competing outlooks on religion, nonbelief, and life purpose raise interpretive and normative problems. Dialogue must distinguish a disagreement about truth from respect for people's freedom of conscience.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à discuter avec respect des différences concernant la religion, l'absence de croyance et le sens de la vie.

##### Analyser le pluralisme religieux comme problème philosophique

[analyzeReligiousPluralismAsAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/skills/analyzeReligiousPluralismAsAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare accounts of how conflicting ultimate-belief claims might be understood and evaluated while respecting freedom of conscience.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les réponses philosophiques à des prétentions religieuses concurrentes à la vérité.

##### Analyser la tolérance religieuse comme principe éthique

[analyzeReligiousToleranceAsAnEthicalPrinciple.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/skills/analyzeReligiousToleranceAsAnEthicalPrinciple.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine justifications and limits for respecting divergent religious or nonreligious commitments, distinguishing toleration from endorsement.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réfléchis aux raisons et aux limites du respect des personnes ayant d'autres convictions.

##### Distinguer scepticisme religieux et agnosticisme

[distinguishReligiousSkepticismFromAgnosticism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/skills/distinguishReligiousSkepticismFromAgnosticism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate withholding belief about particular religious claims from positions on the possibility of knowing whether divine reality exists.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les doutes sur les affirmations religieuses de l'incertitude sur ce qui peut être connu.

#### Foi, raison et expérience

Skills: 4

[faithReasonAndExperience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/faithReasonAndExperience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Different accounts of religious knowledge appeal to reasoning, testimony, revelation, or experience. Philosophical examination weighs what these sources can justify and remains distinct from taking part in a religious practice.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la foi, le raisonnement et l'expérience servent à justifier des affirmations religieuses.

##### Comparer foi et raison comme sources de justification

[compareFaithAndReasonAsSourcesOfJustification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/compareFaithAndReasonAsSourcesOfJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze philosophical accounts in which faith and reasoning conflict, complement one another, or play different roles, without assuming one universal religious position.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare différentes façons dont la foi et le raisonnement peuvent se soutenir ou se contester.

##### Distinguer la réflexion philosophique de la pratique religieuse

[distinguishPhilosophicalInquiryFromReligiousPractice.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/distinguishPhilosophicalInquiryFromReligiousPractice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate reasoning about religious claims from performing rituals, accepting revelation, or participating in a tradition.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue la discussion d'idées religieuses de la participation à des pratiques religieuses.

##### Évaluer le récit d'un miracle présumé

[evaluateAReportedMiracleClaim.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/evaluateAReportedMiracleClaim.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Weigh testimony, background assumptions, and plausible alternative explanations when assessing an extraordinary event claim without prejudging its truth.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue l'affirmation d'un événement extraordinaire en confrontant témoignages et explications alternatives.

##### Évaluer l'expérience religieuse comme preuve

[evaluateReligiousExperienceAsEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/evaluateReligiousExperienceAsEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the possible warrant of reported transcendent experience, distinguishing the fact of having an experience from the explanation proposed for it.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore si une expérience religieuse personnelle peut étayer une affirmation plus générale.

#### Réalité ultime et divinité

Skills: 8

[ultimateRealityAndDivinity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/ultimateRealityAndDivinity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Religious and nonreligious accounts of ultimate reality include competing conceptions of divinity and nontheistic accounts of liberation or existence. Their arguments may invoke experience, explanation, definition, or objections, without settling a worldview by stipulation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine les arguments sur les explications ultimes et les différentes conceptions de la divinité.

##### Analyser un argument cosmologique

[analyzeACosmologicalArgument.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/analyzeACosmologicalArgument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate reasoning from existence, dependence, contingency, or causation toward an ultimate explanation, including challenges to its assumptions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue les arguments qui partent de la dépendance ou de la causalité pour conclure à une cause ultime.

##### Analyser un argument du dessein

[analyzeADesignArgument.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/analyzeADesignArgument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether order or complexity supports an inference to a designer, considering the evidential relevance of natural alternatives.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Demande-toi si la complexité ou l'ordre peuvent constituer des indices d'un dessein intelligent.

##### Analyser un argument du mal

[analyzeAnArgumentFromEvil.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/analyzeAnArgumentFromEvil.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how suffering and wrongdoing challenge particular accounts of divinity and assess the strengths of proposed philosophical responses.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue comment la souffrance remet en question certaines conceptions de la divinité.

##### Analyser un argument ontologique

[analyzeAnOntologicalArgument.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/analyzeAnOntologicalArgument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate an a priori argument that moves from a proposed concept of God or maximal greatness toward existence, examining whether its logical premises and modal assumptions warrant the conclusion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les arguments qui cherchent à déduire l'existence divine d'une définition.

##### Analyser des conceptions religieuses non théistes de la réalité

[analyzeNontheisticReligiousAccountsOfReality.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/analyzeNontheisticReligiousAccountsOfReality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how a particular nontheistic religious tradition understands reality, suffering, liberation, or ultimate truth without incorrectly treating absence of a creator deity as absence of religion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore des visions religieuses qui ne reposent pas sur la croyance en une divinité créatrice.

##### Comparer les conceptions philosophiques de la divinité

[comparePhilosophicalConceptionsOfDivinity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/comparePhilosophicalConceptionsOfDivinity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish personal, impersonal, and plural conceptions of ultimate reality while recognizing significant diversity within traditions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les conceptions personnelles, impersonnelles et plurielles de la réalité ultime.

##### Évaluer une explication ultime proposée

[evaluateAProposedUltimateExplanation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/evaluateAProposedUltimateExplanation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider whether an account of why anything exists explains more than it assumes and what further questions it raises.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Demande-toi ce qu'une explication de l'existence éclaire réellement et ce qu'elle présuppose.

##### Reconstruire un argument philosophique sur la divinité

[reconstructAPhilosophicalArgumentAboutDivinity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/reconstructAPhilosophicalArgumentAboutDivinity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify premises and conclusion in a theistic, atheistic, or agnostic argument without treating the position as settled by its name.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère les raisons avancées dans un argument pour ou contre le divin.

### Philosophie des sciences

Groups: 4 · Skills: 26

[philosophyOfScience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/philosophyOfScience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific inquiry is examined as a way of building, testing, and revising explanations. The focus is on general methodology and evidential justification; physics, biology, psychology, and other sciences own their domain-specific investigations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les affirmations scientifiques sont testées, étayées, révisées et contestées.

#### Preuves et inférence causale

Skills: 6

[evidenceAndCausalInference.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/evidenceAndCausalInference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Observations become informative only through assumptions about measurement, variation, and alternative explanations. The quality of a causal conclusion is not identical to the size of an observed association.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore ce que les preuves peuvent établir, ou non, sur les relations de causalité.

##### Évaluer la validité d'une mesure

[assessMeasurementValidity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/assessMeasurementValidity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether an operational measure genuinely captures the construct a researcher claims to study.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Vérifie si une mesure évalue réellement ce qu'elle prétend mesurer.

##### Évaluer la représentativité d'un échantillon

[assessSampleRepresentativeness.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/assessSampleRepresentativeness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether selection and coverage allow findings to extend to the population named in a conclusion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Détermine si les participants choisis représentent la population plus large.

##### Distinguer corrélation et causalité

[distinguishCorrelationFromCausation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/distinguishCorrelationFromCausation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why two variables varying together does not alone show that changing one produces the other.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais que deux variables évoluant ensemble ne prouvent pas que l'une cause l'autre.

##### Évaluer une conclusion causale d'une étude

[evaluateACausalConclusionFromAStudy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/evaluateACausalConclusionFromAStudy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Judge how design, alternative explanations, limitations, and observed evidence jointly support or weaken a causal claim.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue une affirmation causale en examinant le protocole, les preuves et d'autres explications.

##### Évaluer l'incertitude d'échantillonnage

[evaluateSamplingUncertainty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/evaluateSamplingUncertainty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how sample size, observed variation, and sampling processes affect the precision of an estimate, distinguishing imprecision from whether the sample represents its target population.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment le choix et la variation de l'échantillon influencent la précision d'une estimation.

##### Repérer un facteur de confusion

[identifyAConfoundingFactor.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/identifyAConfoundingFactor.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Find a plausible third variable or selection process capable of producing an apparent relationship.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Trouve un troisième facteur pouvant expliquer une relation apparente.

#### Plan expérimental

Skills: 9

[experimentalDesign.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/experimentalDesign.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Controlled investigations attempt to isolate explanatory factors while managing confounding, expectations, and ethical constraints. Particular safeguards solve different problems and are not interchangeable.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la conception d'une étude peut rendre les comparaisons plus fiables.

##### Contrôler les conditions expérimentales pertinentes

[controlRelevantExperimentalConditions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/controlRelevantExperimentalConditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Hold relevant background conditions stable or account for them so comparisons are not undermined by extraneous differences.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Garde constantes les conditions importantes pour que la comparaison soit équitable.

##### Évaluer l'éthique de la recherche

[evaluateResearchEthics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/evaluateResearchEthics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess informed consent, voluntary participation, proportionality of risk, participant protection, and integrity of reporting in proposed research; distinguish ethical permissibility from whether a study can yield valid data.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine le consentement, la sécurité et la sincérité des comptes rendus d'une étude proposée.

##### Expliquer un contrôle par placebo

[explainAPlaceboControl.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/explainAPlaceboControl.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish a comparison intended to account for expectations or contextual effects from an active treatment or mere absence of intervention.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi comparer à un placebo aide à distinguer effets du traitement et attentes.

##### Expliquer le double insu

[explainDoubleBlinding.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/explainDoubleBlinding.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when both participants and interacting researchers or outcome assessors are kept unaware of allocation, and why such a design is neither always feasible nor universally required.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment l'insu des participants et des chercheurs peut réduire certains biais.

##### Expliquer l'assignation aléatoire

[explainRandomAssignment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/explainRandomAssignment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show how allocating participants or units by chance can reduce systematic pre-existing differences between comparison groups.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment répartir les participants au hasard peut limiter les différences préexistantes.

##### Expliquer l'insu simple

[explainSingleBlinding.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/explainSingleBlinding.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify which party is kept unaware of assigned conditions and how that may reduce particular expectation-related effects.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment cacher la condition attribuée à une partie peut limiter l'effet des attentes.

##### Expliquer le rôle d'un groupe témoin

[explainThePurposeOfAControlGroup.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/explainThePurposeOfAControlGroup.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the comparison condition needed to interpret an intervention's effect where a control group is appropriate.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment un groupe témoin permet d'isoler l'effet d'une intervention.

##### Repérer une variable dépendante

[identifyADependentVariable.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/identifyADependentVariable.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the measured response or outcome whose variation an investigation attempts to account for, distinguishing outcome measurement from factors that may influence it.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais ce que l'étude mesure comme résultat.

##### Repérer une variable indépendante

[identifyAnIndependentVariable.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/identifyAnIndependentVariable.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the hypothesized influence, manipulated factor, or explanatory predictor in a specified study, including designs where the researcher observes rather than sets its value.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère le facteur censé influencer le résultat d'une étude.

#### Questions et hypothèses

Skills: 5

[questionsAndHypotheses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/questionsAndHypotheses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Research design starts with propositions that can be addressed using evidence. Questions, hypotheses, predictions, and observation serve different epistemic roles.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à distinguer questions de recherche, hypothèses, prédictions et observations.

##### Comparer recherche observationnelle et expérimentale

[compareObservationalAndExperimentalResearch.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/skills/compareObservationalAndExperimentalResearch.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish observing variation as it occurs from deliberately manipulating an explanatory factor.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue l'observation des variations naturelles de la modification volontaire d'un facteur.

##### Déduire une prédiction d'une hypothèse

[deriveAPredictionFromAHypothesis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/skills/deriveAPredictionFromAHypothesis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain what should be observed under specified conditions if a proposed explanation is correct.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Prévois ce qui devrait arriver dans des conditions données si l'hypothèse est correcte.

##### Distinguer observation et interprétation

[distinguishObservationFromInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/skills/distinguishObservationFromInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate a recorded outcome from the theory-dependent explanation assigned to that outcome.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Sépare ce qui a été observé de l'explication qu'on en donne.

##### Formuler une hypothèse vérifiable

[formulateATestableHypothesis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/skills/formulateATestableHypothesis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** State a possible answer whose empirical implications can be investigated rather than relying on an unfalsifiable restatement.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Propose une explication que des observations pourraient mettre à l'épreuve.

##### Formuler une question étudiable empiriquement

[formulateAnEmpiricallyInvestigableQuestion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/skills/formulateAnEmpiricallyInvestigableQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify observations or comparisons that could bear on a precise research question, while recognizing questions outside empirical testing.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Pose une question qui peut être étudiée à partir de données pertinentes.

#### Théories et pratique scientifique

Skills: 6

[theoriesAndScientificPractice.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/theoriesAndScientificPractice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific conclusions are provisional but not arbitrary: shared procedures, criticism, reproducibility, and explanatory success distinguish responsible inquiry from mere assertion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la critique et de nouvelles preuves font évoluer les théories scientifiques.

##### Distinguer théorie scientifique et hypothèse

[distinguishAScientificTheoryFromAHypothesis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/skills/distinguishAScientificTheoryFromAHypothesis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize a theory as a broad explanatory framework supported and refined through inquiry, not merely an untested guess.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue une théorie scientifique générale et éprouvée d'une hypothèse particulière.

##### Évaluer l'examen scientifique par les pairs

[evaluateScientificPeerReview.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/skills/evaluateScientificPeerReview.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish expert scrutiny of methods and interpretation from a guarantee that published claims are correct.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais la valeur et les limites de l'évaluation des travaux scientifiques par des spécialistes.

##### Évaluer la réfutabilité d'une affirmation

[evaluateTheFalsifiabilityOfAClaim.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/skills/evaluateTheFalsifiabilityOfAClaim.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether plausible observations could count against a proposition without treating falsifiability as the sole criterion of science.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Demande-toi quelles observations pourraient contredire une affirmation scientifique.

##### Expliquer l'autocorrection scientifique

[explainScientificSelfCorrection.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/skills/explainScientificSelfCorrection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how independent criticism and new evidence can revise established models, without equating uncertainty with lack of knowledge.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment de nouvelles preuves peuvent amener la science à revoir ses conclusions.

##### Expliquer le rôle de la réplication

[explainTheRoleOfReplication.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/skills/explainTheRoleOfReplication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show why repeating an investigation can expose chance results, context dependence, or methodological errors.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi répéter une étude aide à vérifier ses conclusions.

##### Repérer les conflits d'intérêts en recherche

[identifyConflictsOfInterestInResearch.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/skills/identifyConflictsOfInterestInResearch.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize relationships that may create incentives to bias design, interpretation, or publication without assuming misconduct.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère les liens susceptibles d'influencer la conduite ou le compte rendu d'une étude.

### Philosophie sociale et politique

Groups: 6 · Skills: 23

[socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Political and social philosophy examines the justification of collective rules, institutions, authority, rights, and distributions of benefits and burdens. It asks normative questions rather than describing the chronology of regimes or the mechanics of markets.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine les fondements moraux des lois, des droits, de l'autorité et des décisions collectives.

#### Justice et égalité

Skills: 4

[justiceAndEquality.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/justiceAndEquality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Claims of fairness depend on what is distributed, who qualifies for consideration, and which differences are morally relevant.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment différentes conceptions de l'équité façonnent l'organisation sociale.

##### Analyser l'équité procédurale

[analyzeProceduralFairness.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/skills/analyzeProceduralFairness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the transparency, consistency, and opportunity to contest a decision independent of who benefits from its outcome.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Détermine si la procédure de décision est juste, même lorsque son résultat est contesté.

##### Comparer les principes de répartition

[compareDistributivePrinciples.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/skills/compareDistributivePrinciples.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate allocation by need, merit, equality, entitlement, or sufficiency and identify conflicts between principles.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue si les ressources doivent être réparties selon le besoin, le mérite, les droits ou l'égalité.

##### Distinguer égalité et équité

[distinguishEqualityFromEquity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/skills/distinguishEqualityFromEquity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare giving identical treatment with responding to relevant differences in needs or disadvantage, without assuming one always settles justice.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare le traitement identique des personnes avec la prise en compte des différences pertinentes.

##### Évaluer une affirmation de discrimination

[evaluateAClaimAboutDiscrimination.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/justiceAndEquality/skills/evaluateAClaimAboutDiscrimination.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether a distinction in treatment is relevantly justified or imposes an unfair burden on a protected or vulnerable group.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine si des différences de traitement sont justifiées ou discriminatoires.

#### Philosophie du droit

Skills: 4

[philosophyOfLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/philosophyOfLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Jurisprudence considers what makes a norm legally valid, why legal institutions claim authority, and how rules should be interpreted. These questions are not limited to any country's current statutes or to political legitimacy in general.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore ce qui donne autorité aux règles juridiques et comment les interpréter.

##### Analyser le positivisme juridique

[analyzeLegalPositivism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/analyzeLegalPositivism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate accounts that identify valid law through social sources or institutional practices rather than making moral correctness a necessary condition of legal validity.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine la thèse selon laquelle la validité du droit dépend de sources sociales plutôt que de sa valeur morale.

##### Analyser la théorie du droit naturel

[analyzeNaturalLawTheory.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/analyzeNaturalLawTheory.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate theories that understand legal authority or validity as importantly connected to morality, distinguishing different versions of this connection.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les conceptions reliant l'autorité du droit à des principes moraux.

##### Analyser l'État de droit

[analyzeTheRuleOfLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/analyzeTheRuleOfLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine principles such as generality, accessibility, prospectivity, consistent application, and constraints on arbitrary power as grounds for evaluating a legal order.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore les principes qui rendent la loi publique, prévisible et protègent contre le pouvoir arbitraire.

##### Évaluer les théories d'interprétation juridique

[evaluateTheoriesOfLegalInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/philosophyOfLaw/skills/evaluateTheoriesOfLegalInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how text, legislative purpose, precedent, and institutional role support competing interpretations of a legal provision without deciding a real legal dispute.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine comment le texte, l'objectif et les précédents influencent l'interprétation d'une règle juridique.

#### Autorité politique

Skills: 4

[politicalAuthority.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/politicalAuthority.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Institutions exercise collective power that requires justification. Political legitimacy, coercion, and obedience are distinct concepts.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine ce qui rend l'autorité politique légitime, au-delà de sa seule puissance.

##### Analyser la désobéissance civile

[analyzeCivilDisobedience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/analyzeCivilDisobedience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider the moral conditions, aims, and limits of nonviolent principled lawbreaking without equating legality with morality.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Discute des raisons morales de désobéir aux lois, par principe et sans violence.

##### Comparer les arguments du contrat social

[compareSocialContractArguments.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/compareSocialContractArguments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how alternative accounts use consent, cooperation, security, or fairness to justify political obligations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue les raisons avancées pour justifier le pouvoir des institutions publiques d'établir des règles.

##### Évaluer la légitimité de l'autorité politique

[evaluateTheLegitimacyOfPoliticalAuthority.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/evaluateTheLegitimacyOfPoliticalAuthority.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine reasons offered to justify the right to make binding public decisions, not merely whether an institution controls force.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les arguments justifiant le gouvernement par le consentement, la sécurité ou la coopération.

##### Évaluer les limites de la contrainte étatique

[evaluateTheLimitsOfStateCoercion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/politicalAuthority/skills/evaluateTheLimitsOfStateCoercion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess competing grounds for restricting individual actions, such as preventing harm or protecting rights.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réfléchis aux situations où limiter la liberté personnelle pourrait être justifié.

#### Raison publique et vie civique

Skills: 4

[publicReasonAndCivicLife.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/publicReasonAndCivicLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** People with incompatible values must still make shared decisions. Philosophical inquiry examines how disagreements can be handled under pluralism and institutional accountability.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment des personnes aux valeurs différentes peuvent justifier des décisions touchant tout le monde.

##### Analyser la légitimité démocratique

[analyzeDemocraticLegitimacy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/analyzeDemocraticLegitimacy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the roles of participation, representation, minority protections, and accountability in justifying collective decisions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine comment la participation, la représentation et la responsabilité justifient la démocratie.

##### Évaluer un argument sur le bien commun

[assessAnArgumentAboutTheCommonGood.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/assessAnArgumentAboutTheCommonGood.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine who benefits, who bears costs, and whether a proposed collective interest disregards legitimate dissent.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine quels intérêts sont représentés par une affirmation sur le bien commun.

##### Distinguer raisons publiques et préférences privées

[distinguishPublicReasonsFromPrivatePreferences.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/distinguishPublicReasonsFromPrivatePreferences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify justifications aimed at principles others can evaluate, rather than asserting that a personal desire must settle collective policy.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue les raisons publiques des préférences que les autres n'ont aucune raison de partager.

##### Évaluer les conceptions de l'obligation politique

[evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider when citizens may have moral reasons to obey, criticize, or resist laws irrespective of mere fear of punishment.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi on peut suivre, contester ou résister aux lois.

#### Droits et liberté

Skills: 4

[rightsAndLiberty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/rightsAndLiberty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A right may protect a person's action, claim, or status and create obligations for others. Competing rights can require principled reconciliation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore ce que chacun peut revendiquer comme droit et ce que signifie la liberté.

##### Analyser un conflit entre droits

[analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whose claims compete and evaluate justified limits without assuming one right automatically cancels all others.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réfléchis à la manière de résoudre des conflits entre des droits importants.

##### Distinguer liberté négative et positive

[distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast freedom from interference with capacities or opportunities to act, while recognizing debates about their relationship.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare l'absence d'ingérence avec la capacité d'agir efficacement.

##### Distinguer droits et privilèges

[distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a claim concerns an entitlement owed to a person or an advantage conditional on discretionary permission.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue un droit dû à une personne d'un privilège accordé sous condition.

##### Expliquer la liberté de conscience

[explainFreedomOfConscience.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/explainFreedomOfConscience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess why protecting personal belief and nonbelief may matter independently of agreement with any particular worldview.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi chacun devrait pouvoir avoir des convictions religieuses ou non religieuses.

#### Technologie et société

Skills: 3

[technologyAndSociety.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/technologyAndSociety.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Technological artifacts and institutions shape the practical conditions of action, social change, and control. Philosophical analysis evaluates these mediation and agency claims rather than measuring product usage or engineering device performance.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à analyser comment les technologies influencent l'action humaine et la société.

##### Analyser l'autonomie humaine dans les systèmes techniques

[analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate when reliance on automated or networked systems enhances or constrains meaningful choice and control, separate from the narrower ethics of individual algorithmic decisions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore quand la technologie augmente ou réduit la maîtrise d'une personne sur ses décisions.

##### Analyser la médiation technique

[analyzeTechnologicalMediation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/analyzeTechnologicalMediation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how a technological artifact changes the available actions, relationships, or choices through which people engage the world, without reducing the issue to the device's technical operation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Examine comment la technologie modifie les choix et les relations accessibles aux personnes.

##### Évaluer le déterminisme technologique

[evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess arguments that technological development determines social arrangements, including objections based on political choice, design, and historical contingency.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Demande-toi si le changement technologique détermine à lui seul l'évolution des sociétés.
